answer: Rule: SYSTEMATIC if (reversibility=0 AND blast>=2) OR (contradiction>=2 AND density>=2) OR weighted_score>=6, else RAPID. Weighted score = (2-reversibility)+blast+density+contradiction. Live calls: Q1=RAPID (score 0), Q2=SYSTEMATIC (score 8, gates ['irreversible-and-high-blast', 'high-contradiction-and-dense-literature']), Q3=RAPID (score 2). Rapid vs systematic fingerprints differ (2f8b970cd514 vs c3df9a5d9595). Q1 negative control: rapid missed 0 decision-relevant claims. Q2: rapid missed 5 decision-relevant claims (['C-4-COMPARISON', 'C-50-METHODS', 'C-GANANN-COMPARE', 'C-RR-BIAS-RISK', 'C-RR-LESS-COMPREHENSIVE']). Q3: rapid missed 0 decision-relevant claims. Always-systematic mutant fails the negative control. SUCCESS:RES-0192
